text.en:
Combat Duty Pay. The rate of Combat Duty Pay of the officers
and enlisted personnel
of the AFP specified
under EO No. 1017 (s. 1985) is hereby
rendered ineffective. ln its stead, the rate shall now be five hundred pesos (P500.00)

Persons Entitled to Gombat Duty Pay. Officers and enlisted
performing
combat duties/activities
as defined in regulations
to be issued by
the secretary of National Defense are entitled to receive cornbat Duty Pay,
3. Combat Incentive Pay. The provisions
which provide
that the members
of the AFP who figure directly in actual combat against
members of various insurgent,
terrorist and lawless groups shall be entitled to an
additional
combat incentive
pay of one hundred fifty pesos (P150.00) per day white
engaged in combat operation
is hereby revived and given effect, subject
conditions:
The operation
must be for a specific combai mission that is duly covered
by an Operations
Order (OPORD)
or a Fragmentary
Order (FRAG-O),

The personnel involved in combat must be in the published task
organization
of the OPORD.
The total additional combat incentive pay for each individual shall not
exceed one thousand
five hundred
per OPORD/FRAG-
This combat incentive pay shall be over and above the five hundred pesos
(P500.00) per month combat duty pay that the members of the AFP assigned in field
units are entitled to.
Funding Requirement. The initial funding requirements
to implement
this Executive
Order shall be drawn from the Personal Services
(PS) savings realized by the AFP during FY 2010 and FY 2011, as may be determined
by the AFP. Succeeding funding for this purpose shall be included in the General
Appropriations
Act, provided that the actual roster of military personnel is submitted
the Department
of Budget and Management
(DBM). The said list shall be the basis for
allocating
funds for the purpose in the succeeding
fiscal years.
5. Separability. lf any provision of this Executive Order is declared
invalid or uhconstitutional,
the other provisions not affected thereby shall remain valid
and subsisting.

Repeat. All executive
orders, rules and regulations
and other parts
thereof, which are inconsistent
with this Executive
Order, are hereby revoked, amended
or modified accordingly.

Effectivity. This Executive Order shall take effect starting 01
January 2011 and thereafter.
DONE in the City of Manila,
year of Our Lord, Two Thousand and Eleven.
